title: Project session rules
location: AGENTS.md managed block + project-owned rules; harness-specific native adapters
basis: Inspected managed rules and harness-specific native adapters
note: Project-owned additions carry local policy. Yoke’s own production rules and Platform runbooks stay in their owning projects.
current: The managed AGENTS.md block is a short map of Yoke, seven plain rules no command enforces, Writing to users, the architecture pointer and the read recipe (about 2.8 KB). Agent judgment lives in one file, .yoke/docs/agents/rules.md, with Claude-only steps in .yoke/docs/agents/claude.md. Each command's --help ends with its recipe, and each refusal names its reason and fix. Native adapter/source files and automated install tests do not prove the complete actual payload received by an unrelated-project main or worker.
desired: Keep existing project rules; a short map plus only the obligations no command can enforce, with one pointer to .yoke/docs/agents/rules.md. Add no second project startup block.
